## What changes

Describe the change in a few sentences. Cite the paragraphs of the protocol or of the binding that it touches.

## Why

Give the reason. Link the issue.

## Checks

- [ ] A conformance case cites each changed rule, and `conformance/COVERAGE.md` lists it.
- [ ] I ran `scripts/ci.sh`.
- [ ] I ran `python3 -I scripts/check-docs.py`.
- [ ] I updated `docs/CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] The HTML of the site follows the Markdown of the protocol and of the binding.
- [ ] The text has no real host name, no real address and no secret.
